name: carepath
description: CarePath Sonipat — ambulance SOS, AI care guide, hospital finder and insurance help.

scripts.setup: npm install --prefix server --legacy-peer-deps && npm install --prefix web --legacy-peer-deps && node -e "require('fs').existsSync('server/.env')||require('fs').copyFileSync('server/.env.example','server/.env')" && npm run seed --prefix server -- --demo
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run typecheck --prefix web
